thread:
alex: Heads up — seeing a big spike of 503s for /v1/embeddings and /v1/generate starting ~12:04 PST. Multiple customers (acme-corp, beta-app) timing out. Upstream inference worker returning 503s; logs show segfaults and GPU resets. Anyone oncall?

infra-bot: ALERT: upstream-worker-503-rate high on gpu-pool-6 (120/min) — auto-ticket created.

sahil: I'm on it. grabbing coredumps + nvml logs. any repro clues from CS? @maya

alex: Pattern: high qps + large embed batches/long contexts. Model swap to quant-v2 happened ~4m before spike. Excerpt from runner.log: 
```
E 2024-09-14T19:04:12Z infer: worker(12345) caught SIGSEGV at 0x7fffbadf
Backtrace:
  0x7f8a1a2b in eval_kv_cache at src/runtime/kvcache.cpp:412
  0x7f8a1c9d in forward_step at src/runtime/forward.cpp:123
  ...
Process killed by signal 11 (SIGSEGV)
```

chris: dmesg shows NV driver reset: `NVRM: GPU 0000:65:00: GPU HANG: pid 12345, reason: Xid 79` — looks like GPU hang/reset. Could be driver-level or a bad memory write from quantized kernel. Are we seeing OOM prior to segfault?

sahil: NVML sample: `GPU 0: memory 100% (16384MB/16384MB) at 19:04:11, process 12345 (infer-runner) killed`. So memory ballooning then crash. Also saw `cudaErrorIllegalAddress` in some logs.

maya: CS update: ACME on support call, customers seeing timeouts and billing breaks. They want ETA. Short-term mitigation request: route their traffic off this pool and disable hotswap to the quant-v2 model. Can support message customers about fallbacks?

support-bot: Ticket #45821 (ACME) created and linked to incident 1789990000.

alex: Repro steps I'm trying locally (staging): send 8 parallel streaming embed requests with very long context (200k tokens) and kv_prefetch enabled. Example curl: 
```bash
for i in {1..8}; do \
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -d '{"model":"open/quant-v2","input":"'$(yes "long context" | head -n 200000 | tr -d '\n')'"}' &
done
```
If you can reproduce, add to the thread.

sahil: Confirmed repro on staging. Also reproduces if `kv_prefetch.threads` > 4. I'll attach a smaller repro script. Quick python test: 
```python
# repro.py (staging)
import requests, threading

def req():
    requests.post('https://staging.api/v1/embeddings', json={"model":"open/quant-v2","input":"x"*200000})

threads = [threading.Thread(target=req) for _ in range(8)]
for t in threads: t.start()
for t in threads: t.join()
```

chris: Short-term mitigation plan: drain gpu-pool-6, route traffic to fallback model `redwood/llm-base-1.1` and to gpu-pool-2 which runs conservative kernel configs. Also disable auto-hot-swap for quant-v2 for now. I'll push routing rule in ~5m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

alex: Action items: sahil — collect core dumps, gdb bt, and NVML timelines; chris — drain + routing change + disable hot-swap; maya — CS comms (notify affected customers + offer credits). I'll coordinate.

sahil: Early gdb backtrace from coredump (truncated):
```
#0 0x7f8a1a2b in eval_kv_cache (this=0x55e... ) at kvcache.cpp:412
#1 0x7f8a1c9d in forward_step (ctx=0x55e...) at forward.cpp:123
#2 0x7f8a2d00 in run_inference_loop at runner.cpp:789
#3 0x7f89f0b3 in start_thread (arg=0x7f...) at pthread_create.c:0
```
Looks like corruption during KV cache evaluation when prefetch threads are high.

infra-bot: INFO: routing change deployed to service-gateway — 12% of traffic shifted to fallback model; drain started on gpu-pool-6.

maya: Draft CS message: "We routed your requests to a compatible model to restore availability. We're investigating a root cause related to GPU memory pressure during large-embed bursts and will not bill for failed requests in the last hour. We'll follow up with a timeline and postmortem." Thoughts? 

alex: Good. Update: error rate down from ~110/min 503s to ~2/min after routing/drain. Keeping this thread open until we have cores + full root cause. Will open a postmortem ticket and tag eng-ml.

chris: Follow-ups for postmortem: reproduce matrix (qps, context length, kv_prefetch threads), driver version, cuda/driver kernel logs, quant kernel regression tests. Suggest we block auto-hot-swap for quant builds until we validate on staging.

sahil: Collected artifacts: cores+nvml+tshark. Uploading to S3 path: s3://redwood-incident-artifacts/1789990000/ — will attach to the postmortem.

maya: CS done: ACME notified, offered temporary credit, they back to service.

alex: Closing immediate escalation — tracked for postmortem. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
